```{r setup}
library(StatmechR)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
data("vig1_data")
```

```{r}
str(vig1_data)
```
```{r}
plot_true_curves(dat = vig1_data, X = "time", plot_group = "location", 
                 count = "cases", legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
mask_day <- 50

mask_dat <- vig1_data %>% 
  filter(time <= mask_day & is.na(time) == F) %>% 
  group_by(location) %>% 
  arrange(time) %>% 
  mutate(first_day = which(cases > 0)[1], 
         epi_t = time - (first_day - 1), 
         c_cases = cumsum(cases)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  arrange(location, time) %>% 
  select(-time, -first_day) %>% 
  mutate(epi_t = ifelse(is.na(epi_t) == T, 0, epi_t))
```

```{r}
ecs <- split(mask_dat$cases, f = mask_dat$location)
curcases <- sapply(ecs, sum)
```

```{r}
enddate <- max(vig1_data$time, na.rm = T)
tau <- round(max(vig1_data$time, na.rm = T) - mask_day)
```

```{r}
starting_vals <- data.frame(K = (pmax(5, 2 * sapply(ecs, sum))), #final size
                            pt = (sapply(ecs, length)), # peak time
                            sp = log(sapply(ecs, length) / 5))

epimdl <- fit_norm_model(ecs2, normmdl, starting_vals, norm_error2, cores = 4, 
                         tau = tau)
```
